page.title: Newsletters
page.subtitle: Manage newsletters, subscribers and automated notifications

placeholders.auto: “Automations” tab — to be implemented in Phase 7

imageUploader.hint: Images: {{used}} / {{max}}. Allowed: JPG, PNG, WebP. Stored in Firebase.

confirm.deleteBody: Are you sure you want to delete “{{name}}” ({{email}})? This cannot be undone.
confirm.blockBody: “{{name}}” ({{email}}) will no longer receive emails. You can unblock them later.

editPrefs.title: Subscriber categories
editPrefs.description: Pick which categories this subscriber receives.

sendPersonal.title: Personal email to subscriber
sendPersonal.description: Send a direct message to {{name}} ({{email}}). The email uses the same newsletter design but is not stored in history.
sendPersonal.blockedNotice: This subscriber is blocked or unsubscribed and will not receive the email.

subStats.title: Subscriber overview
subStats.subtitle: Quick snapshot of the subscriber base.

autoSettings.title: Automated newsletters
autoSettings.subtitle: Cron job overview. Full management in Phase 7.
autoSettings.weeklyDesc: Aggregates new content from the last 7 days and upcoming events. Sent only when there is content for the subscriber.
autoSettings.scheduledDesc: Checks for newsletters with status “Scheduled” and sends them when their scheduled time arrives.

editor.subtitle: Create, schedule and send a newsletter to a selected group of subscribers.

fields.title: Title
fields.titleHint: Internal title for organisation. It is not shown in the email.
fields.subject: Email subject (preheader)
fields.subjectPlaceholder: Short summary shown next to the subject in the inbox
fields.platformUpdatesPlaceholder: Optional. A section in the newsletter for upcoming changes.
fields.platformUpdatesHint: This text appears as a SEPARATE section at the bottom of the newsletter (a list of upcoming platform changes). For a single announcement block with image and link, use the “Add content” button → “Update”.
fields.scheduledAtHint: Timezone: Europe/Sofia. Leave empty to save as a draft.

audience.allDescription: The newsletter will be sent to all active subscribers regardless of their preferences.
audience.segmentDescription: The newsletter will only reach subscribers who have at least one of the selected categories enabled.

status.dirtyHint: Your changes will be saved automatically before sending. You can also click “Save as draft” to be sure.

validation.scheduleRequired: Please choose a date and time.
validation.scheduleFuture: The date and time must be in the future.

preview.heading: Newsletter preview
preview.description: How the newsletter will look in a subscriber's inbox.
preview.testNote: These recipients apply to a real send. The test copy goes ONLY to the email below.
preview.sendTestTo: You will receive a copy at {{email}}
preview.customEmailLabel: Email to send the test to
preview.customEmailPlaceholder: leave empty to use your admin email

messages.needSaveFirst: Please save the draft before sending a test.
messages.sendStarted: Sending has started. Stats will update in a few minutes.

sendNowConfirm.title: Send newsletter now
sendNowConfirm.body: The newsletter will be sent to {{count}} subscribers. This action cannot be undone. Confirm?

addContent.title: Insert content from the platform
addContent.description: Pick content to be inserted into the newsletter as a formatted block (image, title, description, link).

update.heading: Manual update block
update.description: This block is inserted INTO the newsletter body (between paragraphs) as a card with image, title, description and button. For a general section listing upcoming changes, use the “Planned platform updates” field in the main editor.
update.title: Title
update.titlePlaceholder: e.g. “New feature: search on Pensa Club”
update.descriptionPlaceholder: Short explanation of what the update is and why it matters.

wrapper.title: Newsletter administration
wrapper.description: Newsletter and subscriber management has moved to a dedicated admin panel.

empty.title: No newsletters found
empty.description: Create your first newsletter or adjust the filters.

confirm.cancelBody: Are you sure you want to cancel the schedule of “{{title}}”? It will revert to a draft.
